card.name: Just before Virgil or classical authors
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or citation marks right before an ancient author's name, especially Virgil, Horace or Ovid. Seen in classical citations (Serv. ad Aen., Ov. Met.) and in sentences listing classical authors.

modes.label: Classical citations
modes.description: Page numbers or semicolons inside reference lists to ancient sources, where another source such as Virgil or Ovid is likely next.

modes.label: Linking words before an author
modes.description: Words like to, of, including, and, how that introduce a classical poet's name.
modes.example: on several authors<< including>> Virgil and Boethius.

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word starts a classical author's name such as Virgil or Horace.
card.plain: It spots places in a text about ancient literature where the name of a Roman or Greek author is likely to come next.
